title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: Version 1.30.0 of the ant CLI adds ant apply, which creates and updates agents, environments, skills, memory stores, and deployments from files in your repository. Describe each resource in a file, run ant apply, and approve the plan it prints. Commit the claude-lock.json lockfile it writes so that later runs, on your machine or in CI, update the same resources instead of creating new ones. See Manage resources as code with ant apply.
